usage.finalMessage:
I added the `fee-preview <invoice>` command and listed it in `help` right after `run-late-fees`. All 7 tests pass, and the work is committed.
The preview uses the 1.5% fee from the decision in force (DEC-B08), but `run-late-fees` still charges the replaced 2% rate (DEC-B03), so the preview and the real charge differ.
I left `run-late-fees` alone because an existing test expects 2%; Finance needs to decide on that, and it's recorded as an open question in `.work/report.json`.
